feature_policy: city and district identity excluded from predictors
selection_rule: Highest mean of year- and district-grouped macro ROC-AUC among candidates whose mean RMSE is within 2% of logistic regression.

year_grouped.strategy: grouped by complete year; no random row split and no city/district identity predictor
year_grouped.baseline_strategy: Each validation event receives only its training fold's target prevalence.

validation_gate.policy: Every target must have year-grouped ROC-AUC >= 0.65 and lower MSE than a fold-specific prevalence baseline.
